summary: REDAXO is an open-source content management system written in PHP and distributed under the MIT licence. It provides a structured environment for building and maintaining websites, though its primary documentation is written in German. You can run it via containerised setups using Docker.
goodFor: It suits technical teams and developers comfortable with German documentation who need a lightweight, flexible CMS for bespoke web projects.
watchOut: The primary documentation and community resources are predominantly in German, which can present a barrier if you do not read the language. It also occupies a crowded space alongside much larger, widely adopted content management systems.
deployNotes: You will typically need to provision a separate database such as MySQL or MariaDB alongside the application container. Ensure you configure persistent volumes for your uploaded media and database storage, and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
